critic.fix_suggestion: Replace the current 'dot' primitives on the fuselage with an array of 40 rectangular prisms (dimensions: 0.2m x 0.15m x 0.05m). Arrange these prisms in a linear path following the fuselage curvature, using a uniform spacing of 0.8m between each prism center. Align the prisms perpendicular to the surface normal at every point along the curve to ensure consistent orientation across the hull.

discrepancies.observed: A single continuous line of small dots on the upper hump.
discrepancies.reference: A distinct row of individual rectangular windows with defined spacing.
discrepancies.direction_of_fix: replace dots with repeated small box geometries

discrepancies.observed: Flat surface with no visible door frames or structural breaks.
discrepancies.reference: Clearly defined vertical and horizontal recessed lines for passenger doors.
discrepancies.direction_of_fix: add thin rectangular prisms to define door boundaries

discrepancies.observed: A single large, flat white face at the nose.
discrepancies.reference: Multiple distinct panes arranged in a wrap-around cockpit window structure.
discrepancies.direction_of_fix: replace front face with multiple angled planes

discrepancies.observed: Windows are placed randomly or as simple dots without structural spacing.
discrepancies.reference: Uniformly spaced windows following the curvature of the fuselage.
discrepancies.direction_of_fix: reposition window primitives along a curved path
